# Arsvine

> Cross-site contracts. Local repo rules stay in each AGENTS.md.

- [Topology](https://docs.arsvine.com/reference/topology): public origins
- [Health](https://docs.arsvine.com/reference/health): live/ready JSON
- [Catalog](https://docs.arsvine.com/reference/catalog): realm/, realm-content/, ripple/
- [Auth](https://docs.arsvine.com/reference/auth): OIDC resource and scope names
- [New site](https://docs.arsvine.com/reference/new-site): checklist

Internal maintenance pages require an Auth owner session and are not part of this file.
